paragraph: I want to write down a complete thought before deciding which part deserves attention today. The list should stay quiet while I explain the problem, consider a few alternatives, and remember the details that will matter tomorrow. Some sentences are longer because an unfinished idea needs room to develop without turning every clause into a separate task. When I return from another application, I expect the words and the cursor to be ready where I left them. My other device may have added useful notes while this one was away, and those notes should arrive without interrupting this sentence. I can then choose the next useful action, keep the supporting context nearby, and move on with the rest of the day. A simple writing tool should give me space to think at my own pace.
